reading.body:
KPMG's AI record is a services and advisory footprint, not an infrastructure one: no tracked products, no MCP servers, no lawsuits.

The pattern is a professional services firm positioning itself as an AI intermediary. Its site pairs an AI and Technology insights section with a separate AI services page, and describes applying AI tools under its own Trusted AI framework to produce imagery and content. The one concrete enterprise item is a June 2026 press release with Microsoft on scaling enterprise AI agents globally.

For AI scaling, this matters as a demand-side signal rather than a supply-side one. Firms like KPMG sell adoption and governance to enterprises, which is downstream of compute, buildings, and power but does not itself add any. Nothing here indicates KPMG builds, owns, or operates data centers, and the data contains no power, siting, or capacity figures.

What the data does not cover is large. There are no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers, so the absence of those is a limit of the record, not a finding about the company. The profile is drawn from KPMG's own site and a single press release, verified on 2026-10-01, so it reflects self-description rather than independent measurement.

profile_text.body:
KPMG is a for-profit professional services organization whose site presents it as combining human insight and creativity with AI tools, which it says are applied under the KPMG Trusted AI framework to develop imagery and content. Its site organizes AI material under an AI and Technology insights section and a separate AI services page, and it publishes research such as the KPMG Global family business report 2026. It also offers consumer-facing guidance, including safety tips aimed at helping children use AI for creativity, learning and confidence.

On the enterprise side, KPMG's site highlights a June 2026 press release titled "KPMG and Microsoft scale trusted, enterprise AI agents globally," describing work with Microsoft on AI agents for enterprise use. Beyond that, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers associated with the company.
